weft.description: WeftOS agent, one non-interactive turn (weft agent -m). Run with: ruflo team run --team <team> --agent <agent> --host weft. Needs `ruflo team trust-host weft` once per machine (ADR-402 command-host trust). weft reads its provider API key from local .clawft/config.json (gitignored), never from this file: Ruflo's command-host validator rejects secret-named passEnv entries.
